# Repository collaboration metadata

Contribution templates support [brewpi-remix/brewpi-emulator-rmx](https://github.com/brewpi-remix/brewpi-emulator-rmx), the public GitHub repository. The local repository is initialized on `main` with an HTTPS `origin`. The initial publication contains documentation and scaffolding only; no CI workflow, automated test job, or release/publishing workflow has been created.

A future CI definition must run real checks against implemented build/test facilities and report their actual scope. Do not add a passing placeholder job or release automation while the application remains unimplemented.
